source.timestamp_interpretation: UTC from separate author teaching documentation; mirror-only

methods.metric: Love-Otto CV_ind/CV_pop from Euclidean pairwise projected distances
methods.sampling: exhaustive 10-of-n subsets of each eligible day's observed collared individuals
methods.note: Not the protocol's 100 deterministic SHA256 subsamples; an exhaustive measurement-stability sensitivity only.

conclusion: In this one-year teaching subset, selecting which ten GPS-collared females to use can cause substantial within-day CV-ratio variation. This is not evidence about future demographic prediction, nor a measurement-error estimate for the unobserved whole herd.
